purpose: Prove the narrow BrowserRT Kernel Kit wedge: worker agent + object ref + bounded admission + storage-lane block provider + trace evidence.

No OPFS sync access handle storage-lane proof.

No WebGPU, WebNN, WebTransport, WebRTC, mobile lifecycle, or cross-browser conformance claim.
No throughput, latency, SLO, or real performance claim.

stages.label: Boot BrowserRT in a cross-origin-isolated browser page
Spawn a module Worker agent and exchange a BRT1 ping
Transfer an ArrayBuffer object ref and observe sender detachment
Touch a bounded control channel without unbounded queue growth
Admit useful work and reject oversized background work without mutation
Write/read a content-addressed OPFS block through the storage-lane adapter
Reload the page and read the block back in the same temporary browser profile
Produce trace, transcript, non-claim, and audit evidence

usefulness.purpose: Make the Kernel Kit demo answer who benefits, what evidence is earned, and what remains explicitly unproven.

beneficiaryFit.label: Browser IDE / agent workbench builders
beneficiaryFit.why: They need worker orchestration, object refs, and proof receipts more than a generic UI widget.

beneficiaryFit.label: Heavy local web app builders
beneficiaryFit.why: They need local work to avoid main-thread jank and unbounded queues.

beneficiaryFit.label: Local-first storage/tool builders
beneficiaryFit.why: They need OPFS/provider boundaries plus honest non-claims around durability.

beneficiaryFit.label: Runtime library authors
beneficiaryFit.why: They benefit from reusable kernel contracts and a testable evidence envelope.

workflowScorecard.title: Runtime control plane
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Stop scattering boot/capability/trace setup across app code.

workflowScorecard.title: Worker compute agent
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Move CPU work off the UI thread with a lifecycle-managed agent.

workflowScorecard.title: Transfer object ref
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Move bytes by ownership transfer instead of giant JS object graphs.

workflowScorecard.title: Admission/overload gate
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Reject unsafe work without mutating provider state.

workflowScorecard.title: OPFS storage lane
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Route storage through a provider/adapter surface instead of ad hoc browser APIs.

workflowScorecard.title: Trace receipt
workflowScorecard.beneficiaryPain: Leave behind proof artifacts future sessions can audit and refactor around.

acceptanceGate.nextGate: A future session should be able to open the page, run one workflow, inspect the receipt, and explain the non-claims without reading the whole cube.
